sources.title: *Intended Nationally Determined Contribution* (UNFCCC5)
sources.organization: Government of the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan / NEPA; UNFCCC repository
sources.methodology: National consultation and policy synthesis; climate projections and adaptation priorities
sources.limitations: Pre-2021 institutional context; adaptation costs and priorities are plans, not demonstrated implementation.

sources.title: *Second National Communication under the UNFCCC* (UNFCCC1)
sources.methodology: GSWP3 reanalysis; CORDEX regional models; seven-model ensembles; vulnerability/capacity assessment
sources.limitations: Older model generation; precipitation uncertainty high; institutional information predates August 2021.

sources.title: *Climate, Peace and Security Fact Sheet: Afghanistan* (NUPI3)
sources.temporal_coverage: Mainly 2021-2026; climate series to 2024/projections to mid-century
sources.methodology: Literature/secondary-data synthesis and climate-security pathway framework
sources.limitations: Not a causal-identification study; several statistics derive from secondary sources; local examples cannot support national causal claims.

sources.title: *Afghanistan: IPC Acute Food Insecurity Analysis, September 2025-September 2026* (IPCinfo7)
sources.methodology: IPC consensus classification drawing on food security, livelihood, market, climate and humanitarian data
sources.limitations: Classification/projection, not causal evaluation; climate is one of several drivers.

sources.title: *Afghanistan Socioeconomic Review, 2024-2025* (UNDP2)
sources.methodology: WoAA July-Aug 2025 plus administrative/UN sources; bespoke Subsistence Insecurity Index
sources.limitations: Cross-sectional survey evidence; some indices are UNDP constructs; some subgroup analysis restricted to common provinces.

sources.title: *Afghanistan Development Update* (The World Bank9)
sources.methodology: Macroeconomic estimation, administrative sources, World Bank datasets and 2025 Enterprise Survey
sources.limitations: Macro estimates and projections; cannot isolate climatic effects from returns, borders, policy, aid and other drivers.

sources.title: *World Bank & Afghanistan Resilience Trust Fund Support for the People of Afghanistan* (World Bank10)
sources.methodology: Administrative programme description, financing and monitoring arrangements
sources.limitations: Describes intended/current delivery and monitoring architecture, not independent evidence of outcomes or adaptation effectiveness.

sources.title: *Adapting Afghan Communities to Climate-Induced Disaster Risks - Terminal Evaluation* (Evaluation Resource Center6)
geographic_coverage: Project communities, mainly Nangarhar and Jawzjan plus institutional components
sources.methodology: Document review and stakeholder consultation by an external evaluator
sources.limitations: Activities suspended Aug 2021 and never resumed; nearly two-year gap; mainly remote evaluation; incomplete information for some cost-effectiveness questions.

sources.title: *Final Evaluation of UNDP GEF-LDCF2 Project Afghanistan: Strengthening the resilience of rural livelihood options...* (Evaluation Resource Center11)
sources.methodology: Evaluation team review, fieldwork, stakeholder interviews and project monitoring evidence
sources.limitations: Security constrained field access; Uruzgan implementation/evaluation evidence was particularly constrained; weak indicators and M&E limit outcome attribution.

sources.title: *Crisis Compounded: Afghanistan’s Returnees Face an Escalating Water Emergency* (Mercy Corps4)
sources.methodology: Survey of 292 returnee households plus secondary research
sources.limitations: Local sample; many causal attributions are respondent perceptions or report synthesis; groundwater stress has climatic and non-climatic drivers.

sources.title: *No place to stay, no place to go: perspectives from climate-affected areas of Balkh province* (ACAPS12)
geographic_coverage: Dehdadi, Nahr Shahi, Sholgareh districts, Balkh
sources.methodology: Secondary review + experts + purposive qualitative study of 84 participants, interviews/FGDs/households, thematic analysis
sources.limitations: Purposive local study; translation and access limitations; unsuitable for estimating prevalence or national effects.

sources.title: *After return: Rebuilding livelihoods for Afghan women* (ecoi.net13)
sources.methodology: Telephone survey of 582 returnee women, 80 qualitative participants, participatory market work
sources.limitations: Cross-sectional/self-reported; phone frame may exclude women without phones or in highly restrictive households; small earnings subsample; no causal inference.

sources.title: Updated National Adaptation Plan - Burkina Faso
sources.organization: Government of Burkina Faso and United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change
sources.temporal_coverage: Updated national adaptation planning framework current at March 2025.
sources.methodology: The government planning document consolidates national climate risks, sector priorities, institutions, and proposed adaptation actions.
sources.limitations: A policy plan records priorities and intended actions rather than independently evaluated implementation results.

sources.title: Climate Change and Violent Conflict in West Africa: Assessing the Evidence
sources.temporal_coverage: Academic literature available for the systematic review published in February 2022.
sources.methodology: A systematic literature review assesses four mediated climate-insecurity pathways and the strength of the regional evidence base.
sources.limitations: The review finds a limited research base and does not support deterministic or uniformly national causal claims for Burkina Faso.

sources.title: Countering climate-related security risks in the Sahel
sources.temporal_coverage: Research and stakeholder consultation supporting climate-security strategy development through 2024.
sources.methodology: CGIAR researchers investigated risk pathways and consulted national and regional stakeholders to validate findings and identify policy options.
sources.limitations: This results page summarizes research and consultation rather than publishing the full underlying evidence or evaluation design.

sources.title: Climate change and conflict pursue displaced Burkinabes
sources.organization: United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees
sources.temporal_coverage: Displacement, drought, livelihood, and 2020 flood conditions reported through January 2021.
sources.methodology: A UNHCR field story combines interviews, site observation, government displacement data, and cautious expert interpretation.
sources.limitations: Selected households and sites are not nationally representative; the source explicitly cautions against a direct climate-conflict attribution.

sources.title: Burkina Faso country overview
sources.temporal_coverage: Living country overview with current humanitarian and food-security indicators.
sources.methodology: WFP synthesizes operational monitoring, food-security analysis, displacement context, and program activities.
sources.limitations: A living operational page can change and mixes indicators with different reference dates; program descriptions are not independent evaluations.

sources.title: Evaluation of Burkina Faso WFP Country Strategic Plan 2019-2023
sources.organization: World Food Programme Office of Evaluation
sources.temporal_coverage: WFP activities from January 2018 through July 2022; evaluation conducted April 2022 to January 2023.
sources.methodology: The independent evaluation assessed relevance, strategic positioning, outcome contributions, efficiency, and explanatory factors across the country portfolio.
sources.limitations: The evaluation predates later conflict and climate developments and assesses WFP's portfolio rather than all national response systems.

sources.title: Supporting Local Governments and Building Resilience in Burkina Faso
geographic_coverage: All 13 regions and 349 municipalities of Burkina Faso
sources.temporal_coverage: Local governance program results, with crisis-response results concentrated in August 2020 to September 2021.
sources.methodology: A World Bank results brief reports program monitoring data on decentralization, municipal capacity, service continuity, and assistance to displaced households.
sources.limitations: The implementing institution's results brief is not an independent impact evaluation and some outcomes coincide with COVID-19 response rather than climate action.

sources.title: Promoting peaceful transhumance in the Liptako-Gourma region
sources.organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
geographic_coverage: Liptako-Gourma areas of Burkina Faso, Mali, and Niger
sources.temporal_coverage: Lessons from a joint FAO-IOM Peacebuilding Fund initiative implemented from 2020 to 2024.
sources.methodology: The good-practice product synthesizes implementation lessons from work with farmer organizations and national authorities on transhumance, governance, and cohesion.
sources.limitations: Regional lessons do not isolate Burkina Faso effects or establish independent causal impact.

sources.title: Farming communities in Burkina Faso are improving their agricultural practices with innovative weather tools
sources.temporal_coverage: Hydromet implementation and farmer rain-gauge distribution since 2023.
sources.methodology: A project feature reports administrative monitoring, training coverage, institutional roles, and selected participant accounts.
sources.limitations: The page reports outputs and testimonials rather than independent effectiveness or distributional evaluation.

sources.title: Central African Republic - Climate Fact Sheet 2024
sources.organization: Red Cross Red Crescent Climate Centre
sources.temporal_coverage: Historical observations; projections to mid-century and beyond
sources.methodology: Desk synthesis drawing substantially on World Bank/IPCC-type climate evidence
sources.limitations: Not an original modelling study; some projections are regional rather than CAR-specific; rainfall/drought uncertainty is substantial.

sources.title: Plan national initial d’adaptation aux changements climatiques de la République centrafricaine
sources.temporal_coverage: Current planning horizon at publication and future adaptation planning
sources.methodology: Government policy process, sector reviews, consultations and adaptation planning
sources.limitations: Policy intentions do not demonstrate implementation or outcomes; several planned enabling activities lacked finalized budgets.

sources.title: Contribution déterminée au niveau national 3.0 - République centrafricaine (UNFCCC)
sources.methodology: Government inventory, planning, targets, indicators and financing framework
sources.limitations: Self-reported baselines and targets; climate-peace-security language is policy framing, not causal evaluation.

sources.title: First Biennial Transparency Report of the Central African Republic (UNFCCC)
sources.methodology: Government technical reporting, inventories, adaptation assessment and self-evaluation
sources.limitations: Government self-report; adaptation-risk analysis itself is described as largely qualitative and constrained by weak data.

sources.title: Climate, Peace and Security Fact Sheet: Central African Republic (NUPI)
geographic_coverage: CAR, with regional Sahel/Great Lakes mechanisms
sources.methodology: Literature synthesis and expert/interview inputs organized around climate-security pathways
sources.limitations: Explicitly acknowledges limited CAR-specific climate/security monitoring and evidence; some pathway evidence derives from comparable or regional settings.

sources.title: Climate change in the Central African Republic: what threats? (ICRC)
sources.organization: International Committee of the Red Cross
geographic_coverage: CAR, especially pastoral and rural contexts
sources.methodology: Practitioner observations of climate, pastoralism, conflict and humanitarian programming
sources.limitations: Qualitative practitioner source, not representative research; programme activities are not evaluated outcomes.

sources.title: Central African Republic IPC Acute Food Insecurity Analysis / April-August 2026 update (IPCinfo)
sources.methodology: Multi-partner IPC analytical framework integrating food consumption, livelihoods and contributing factors
sources.limitations: IPC classification is analytical, not a causal attribution study; exact publication day was not visible on the opened page.

sources.title: Central African Republic situation overview - Global Appeal 2026
sources.temporal_coverage: Snapshot mainly Sep 2025; outlook to end-2026
sources.methodology: Operational displacement statistics and humanitarian planning
sources.limitations: Planning document; forward caseloads are projections; seasonal floods are only one of multiple pressures.

sources.title: Border town doubling in size as Sudanese refugees arrive in Central African Republic (UNHCR)
sources.methodology: Agency registration/operational statistics and programme reporting
sources.limitations: Highly useful subnational evidence but not nationally generalizable; response activities are outputs rather than evaluated effectiveness.

sources.title: Central African Republic Emergency Food Crisis Response Project (P176754): Implementation Status & Results Report (World Bank)
sources.methodology: Project monitoring indicators and Bank implementation supervision
sources.limitations: Not independent evaluation; several indicators measure reach/output rather than durable resilience.

sources.title: Central African Republic - Emergency Food Crisis Response and Agriculture Re-Launch Project: Project Performance Assessment Report
geographic_coverage: CAR with fieldwork in M’Baïki, Bossembélé and Boali
sources.methodology: Independent document review, interviews and field mission
sources.limitations: Historical rather than current; localized field observations cannot be generalized nationally.

sources.title: Cameroon NDC 3.0 / *Contribution Déterminée au Niveau National Actualisée*
sources.methodology: Government policy synthesizing prior vulnerability/projection evidence
sources.limitations: Climate projections in adaptation section partly reproduce earlier NDC/vulnerability evidence and do not identify model/scenario there. (UNFCCC)

sources.title: *Request for an Arrangement under the Resilience and Sustainability Facility*, Country Report 24/53
sources.methodology: IMF staff assessment, government discussions, World Bank assessment input
sources.limitations: Climate-FCV effects are expert synthesis/prospective risks rather than causal estimates. (IMF)

sources.title: Cameroon data portal
geographic_coverage: National with separate Far North and NW/SW categories
sources.methodology: Government, UNHCR, IOM and OCHA compiled displacement estimates
sources.limitations: Composite sources and methodologies; IDP values are estimates and differ by source. (UNHCR Data Portal)

sources.title: *Japan boosts life-saving food assistance as funding crisis threatens 600,000 people in Cameroon*
sources.methodology: WFP food-security and operational planning evidence
sources.limitations: Agency operational source; food insecurity is explicitly multi-causal; announced assistance is not evidence of effectiveness. (World Food Programme)

sources.title: *Climate-fueled Violence and Displacement in the Lake Chad Basin: Focus on Chad and Cameroon*
geographic_coverage: Far North/Logone Birni; Lake Chad Basin
sources.methodology: Interviews with Cameroonian refugees, authorities, UN/donors/NGOs plus Cameroon-focused phone interviews
sources.limitations: Advocacy source; interview/perception evidence; fieldwork mainly conducted in Chad; no causal counterfactual. (Refugees International)

sources.title: *Implications of Climatic Stressors on Agro-Pastoral Resources Among Mbororo Communities Along the Slopes of Kilum-Ijim Mountain, North West Region, Cameroon*
sources.methodology: 350 randomly administered household questionnaires, interviews and quantitative/qualitative analysis
sources.limitations: Very local; “environmental stressors” combine climatic and non-climatic factors; observational design. (Frontiers)

sources.title: *Youth Agropastoral Entrepreneurship Promotion Programme (AEP-Youth): Impact Assessment Report*
sources.methodology: Non-experimental counterfactual; propensity-score/multistage matching; quantitative surveys + KIIs
sources.limitations: Programme applicants formed sampling frame; no clean treated/control village designation; only four regions. (IFAD)

sources.title: *Project Completion Report Validation - Commodity Value Chain Support Project (PADFA)*
sources.methodology: Independent validation of PCR and supporting evidence
sources.limitations: M&E system itself was weak/non-operational, materially restricting attribution. (IOE)

sources.title: *Country programme document for Cameroon (2027-2031)*
sources.methodology: National statistics, UN evidence and prior Independent Country Programme Evaluation
sources.limitations: Some programme achievements are summarized from the underlying ICPE rather than independently re-evaluated in the CPD. (UNDP)

sources.title: *Joint Monitoring Mission Report: CSO-Led Peacebuilding Project in the Lake Chad Basin Sub-Region - Cameroon and Niger*
sources.methodology: Joint visits/interviews with implementers, beneficiaries, authorities and CSOs
sources.limitations: Not independent; beneficiaries and implementers are part of monitoring process; no counterfactual. (MPTF Gateway)

sources.title: *Implementation Completion and Results Report: Cameroon Inclusive and Resilient Cities Development Project (P156210)*
geographic_coverage: Douala, Yaoundé, Kumba, Ngaoundéré, Batouri, Maroua, Kousséri
sources.methodology: Project M&E, reports, databases, field missions and beneficiary/stakeholder evidence
sources.limitations: Formal satisfaction survey absent; some ex-post analysis used ex-ante benefit assumptions; NBS component incomplete. (World Bank)

sources.title: *National Adaptation Plan to Climate Change (2022-2026)*
sources.organization: DRC Ministry of Environment and Sustainable Development / UNDP support
sources.methodology: Existing vulnerability assessments; CRU and model-ensemble climate information; RCP4.5/RCP8.5; policy consultations
sources.limitations: NAP explicitly notes reliance on older TNC/CRU information and need for updated, targeted studies.

sources.title: *Contribution Déterminée à l'échelle Nationale révisée*
sources.organization: DRC Ministry of Environment and Sustainable Development
sources.methodology: National mitigation/adaptation planning, sector analysis, stakeholder revision process
sources.limitations: Policy commitments and financing needs are not evidence of implementation or outcomes.

sources.title: *Independent Country Programme Evaluation: Democratic Republic of Congo*
geographic_coverage: National plus fieldwork in five provinces
sources.methodology: OECD/DAC-oriented evaluation; document and portfolio review; 362 stakeholders; field visits; qualitative/quantitative triangulation
sources.limitations: Security/access constraints limited fieldwork; North Kivu fieldwork was limited to Goma; women were about one-third of interviewees.

sources.title: *Climate, Peace and Security in Eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo* (SIPRI2)
sources.temporal_coverage: Literature to early 2025; workshop May 2024; KIIs Oct. 2024
sources.methodology: Literature synthesis; workshop with 50+ local stakeholders; five key-informant interviews; climate-security pathway framework
sources.limitations: Qualitative and geographically restricted; cannot establish national causal effects.

sources.title: *Climate Related Security Risks in Eastern DRC: Local Perspectives from North and South Kivu Provinces*
sources.organization: Folke Bernadotte Academy, Réseau CREF, Strong Roots Congo
geographic_coverage: North and South Kivu; Ruzizi evidence
sources.temporal_coverage: Workshop Mar. 2023 plus cited local studies
sources.methodology: Two-day multidisciplinary exploratory workshop and local research presentations
sources.limitations: Explicitly non-exhaustive; several pathway findings reflect participant expertise and presented research rather than a causal study by the report itself.

sources.title: *Climate, Peace and Security Fact Sheet: Democratic Republic of the Congo* (NUPI3)
sources.methodology: Research synthesis of climate-security mechanisms and recommendations
sources.limitations: Broad synthesis; some claims are based on secondary evidence and should not override more recent humanitarian data.

sources.title: *Joint News Release - WFP/FAO: Millions Trapped in Deepening Hunger Crisis in the DRC...* (World Food Programme1)
geographic_coverage: National with focus on North/South Kivu, Ituri, Tanganyika
sources.methodology: Latest IPC update plus agency operational evidence
sources.limitations: Humanitarian situation data, not a causal climate attribution study.

sources.title: *DRC Urban Flood Resilience Project (P508410), Appraisal PID* (World Bank5)
sources.methodology: Project appraisal, DRM assessment and proposed results framework
sources.limitations: Mostly intended mechanisms and targets; not evidence that resilience outcomes were achieved.

sources.title: *DRC Urban Flood Resilience Project - Implementation Status & Results Report* (World Bank6)
sources.methodology: First ISR; indicator and disbursement monitoring
sources.limitations: Very early implementation stage; “satisfactory” rating does not establish final effectiveness.

sources.title: *DRC: Requests for ECF and Resilience and Sustainability Facility Arrangements - Staff Report*, Annex II (IMF7)
sources.methodology: IMF staff analysis drawing on climate datasets, World Bank CCDR, C-PIMA, authorities and other sources
sources.limitations: Secondary synthesis for several climate estimates; some implementation statements are authority-reported.

sources.title: *IMF Executive Board Completes Third ECF Review and Second RSF Review for DRC* (IMF8)
sources.methodology: Programme review and macroeconomic assessment
sources.limitations: Not an independent evaluation of climate-adaptation outcomes; programme performance is broader than climate policy.

sources.title: Updated Nationally Determined Contribution
sources.methodology: Government review, modelling and stakeholder process; 40 adaptation interventions
sources.limitations: Government policy/source; several underlying vulnerability statistics are older.

sources.title: Stocktake of Climate Change Adaptation Interventions in Ethiopia
sources.methodology: Focus groups, structured questionnaires to line ministries, desk review and secondary statistics
sources.limitations: Primarily qualitative and government-led; many adaptation indicators themselves lack data.

sources.title: Ethiopia Country Climate and Development Report
sources.methodology: CMIP6 ensemble, economic/sector modelling, surveys, administrative and literature synthesis
sources.limitations: Explicitly does not model future climate-fragility interaction; some conflict evidence comes from underlying/forthcoming analyses. (World Bank2)

sources.title: Is climate a risk multiplier in Ethiopia?
sources.methodology: Empirical study of climate, food-security and conflict relationships
sources.limitations: Detailed downloadable study could not be fully fetched here; numerical results retained only where reproduced with locator in the CCDR. (World Food Programme1)

sources.title: The World Food Programme’s Contribution to Improving the Prospects for Peace in Ethiopia
sources.methodology: Literature review; remote KIIs; in-person beneficiary/non-beneficiary interviews and focus groups
sources.limitations: Local case; mixed evidence; cannot be generalized nationally. (SIPRI7)

sources.title: Ethiopia emergency
sources.methodology: WFP operational/humanitarian monitoring
sources.limitations: Agency operational reporting; needs and planned reach are not evaluation results. (World Food Programme8)

sources.title: The World Bank Group in Ethiopia, Fiscal Years 2013-23
sources.methodology: Theory-based contribution analysis; portfolio/doc review, interviews, project-team survey, geospatial analysis
sources.limitations: Evaluates World Bank Group engagement, not Ethiopia’s entire adaptation portfolio; period ends FY2023. (Independent Evaluation Group3)

sources.title: WFP supports Ethiopia to build resilient food systems in Somali Region with solar-powered irrigation scheme
sources.methodology: Programme administrative/output reporting
sources.limitations: WFP self-report; production/output figures are not independently evaluated impact estimates. (World Food Programme12)

sources.title: Climate, Peace and Security Fact Sheet: Haiti (2025)
sources.organization: Stockholm International Peace Research Institute and Norwegian Institute of International Affairs
sources.temporal_coverage: Observed and projected climate, displacement, food-security, and security evidence available through May 2025.
sources.methodology: A specialist four-page synthesis organizes secondary evidence around livelihood, mobility, armed-actor, and political-economic pathways.
sources.limitations: The fact sheet synthesizes other sources and does not independently identify causal effects; selected local examples are not nationally representative.

sources.title: Plan National d'Adaptation au Changement Climatique 2022-2030
sources.organization: Government of Haiti and United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change
geographic_coverage: Haiti, national and municipal adaptation planning
sources.methodology: The government plan synthesizes risk and vulnerability evidence, consultations, sector priorities, governance arrangements, costs, and monitoring needs.
sources.limitations: The plan records intended actions and estimated financing needs rather than verified implementation or outcomes.

sources.title: Climate and Health Vulnerability Assessment: Haiti
geographic_coverage: Haiti, with selected subnational health-risk analysis
sources.temporal_coverage: Historical climate and health evidence with future risk discussion through mid-century and beyond.
sources.methodology: A desk-based climate-health assessment combines hazard, exposure, disease, health-system, and adaptive-capacity evidence.
sources.limitations: The assessment is not a causal Climate-FCV study; some national hazard counts combine events with different definitions and periods.

sources.title: Climate Risk and Adaptation Country Profile: Haiti
sources.organization: World Bank Group and Global Facility for Disaster Reduction and Recovery
geographic_coverage: Haiti and Caribbean regional projection context
sources.temporal_coverage: Observed changes since 1960 and older projections to 2060 and 2090.
sources.methodology: A country profile synthesizes historical observations, national communications, IPCC AR4-era projections, and sector risk literature.
sources.limitations: The projections are old, partly regional, and based on earlier model generations; they should not substitute for a current high-resolution baseline.

sources.title: Haiti Country Strategic Plan (2024-2028)
sources.temporal_coverage: Planned operations for 2024-2028, with context indicators available at approval.
sources.methodology: The strategic plan links humanitarian needs, food systems, resilience, government systems, logistics, and intended portfolio outcomes.
sources.limitations: Outcomes and nexus claims are programme intentions, not independent evidence of effectiveness or peace impacts.

sources.title: Evaluation of Haiti WFP Country Strategic Plan 2018-2022
sources.organization: World Food Programme Office of Evaluation
sources.temporal_coverage: Activities from January 2018 through July 2022; evaluation completed in 2023.
sources.methodology: An Office of Evaluation country-portfolio assessment examined strategic positioning, effectiveness, efficiency, and explanatory factors.
sources.limitations: The evaluation predates the latest violence and assesses WFP rather than national response systems or climate-specific outcomes.

sources.title: Haiti faces record displacement amid escalating gang violence
geographic_coverage: Haiti, with Port-au-Prince and displacement-site context
sources.temporal_coverage: Displacement and access conditions reported through June 2024.
sources.methodology: A UN country-team article reports figures and findings from IOM and independent UN human-rights experts.
sources.limitations: The page is a current synthesis rather than a primary displacement dataset or representative household study.

sources.title: Haiti Humanitarian Situation Report No. 11: End-of-year Sitrep
geographic_coverage: Haiti, with violence-affected and displacement locations
sources.temporal_coverage: Humanitarian conditions and UNICEF outputs from January through December 2024.
sources.methodology: A humanitarian situation report synthesizes agency monitoring, IOM displacement data, partner reporting, and programme outputs.
sources.limitations: Operational figures are not independently evaluated outcomes, and access constraints can reduce coverage in gang-controlled areas.

sources.title: Haiti: Escalating armed violence in Port-au-Prince cuts people off from lifesaving services
sources.organization: International Committee of the Red Cross
geographic_coverage: Port-au-Prince metropolitan area and displacement sites
sources.temporal_coverage: Recent armed-violence impacts and ICRC-supported services displayed when accessed in August 2026.
sources.methodology: An operational update combines field observations and ICRC programme monitoring on health, water, displacement, and humanitarian access.
sources.limitations: The page reports selected ICRC-supported activities and cannot measure population-wide service access or climate-specific effects.

sources.title: Strengthening Disaster Risk Management and Transport Infrastructure after a Disaster: The 2010 Haiti Post-Earthquake Experience
geographic_coverage: Haiti, all 140 municipalities and selected transport corridors
sources.temporal_coverage: Project implementation from 2012 through 2020 and reported response use in 2021.
sources.methodology: An implementing-institution results brief reports administrative outputs, a civil-protection performance index, infrastructure works, and response examples.
sources.limitations: The brief is not an independent impact evaluation; earthquake recovery is not climate evidence, although the resulting systems also address storms and floods.

sources.title: Haiti Systematic Country Diagnostic Update: Pathways to Responding to Recurrent Crises and Chronic Fragility
geographic_coverage: Haiti, national development and fragility systems
sources.temporal_coverage: Structural diagnostic evidence and crises through 2022.
sources.methodology: A systematic country diagnostic synthesizes economic, institutional, social, service, disaster-risk, and fragility evidence.
sources.limitations: National synthesis can obscure municipal variation and predates the most recent displacement and armed-group expansion.

sources.title: Human-induced climate change compounded by socio-economic water stressors increased severity of 5-year drought…
sources.methodology: SPEI, rainfall analysis, non-stationary extreme-value methods and vulnerability synthesis
sources.limitations: Rapid attribution analysis; rainfall attribution uncertainty includes no change; some vulnerability statements synthesize secondary sources. (World Weather Attribution)

sources.title: Anthropogenic drought dominates groundwater depletion in Iran
sources.methodology: Groundwater observations, recharge, withdrawal, return flows, precipitation and evaporation
sources.limitations: Historical period; does not measure contemporary FCV outcomes. (Nature)

sources.title: Islamic Republic of Iran Intended Nationally Determined Contribution
sources.organization: Government of Iran; UNFCCC submission, public ESCAP mirror
sources.methodology: Government policy statements and national projections
sources.limitations: Government-authored; some projection methodology is not stated in the accessible text; original UNFCCC file endpoint was inaccessible during verification. (Asia Pacific Energy Policy)

sources.title: Islamic Republic of Iran country overview
sources.methodology: Current economic/development assessment
sources.limitations: Economic synthesis rather than causal climate study; conflict-related statements should be attributed to the World Bank. (World Bank)

sources.title: Iran, Islamic Rep. - World Development Indicators
sources.methodology: WDI indicator compilation
sources.limitations: Indicators have different reference years and underlying methodologies. (World Bank Open Data)

sources.title: Impact of climate change on water crisis and conflicts: Farmers’ perceptions at the ZayandehRud Basin in Iran
sources.organization: Journal of Hydrology: Regional Studies / DOAJ
sources.methodology: Meteorological records + random survey of 301 farmers
sources.limitations: Basin-specific; perceptions cannot by themselves demonstrate objective conflict causality. (Directory of Open Access Journals)

sources.title: Rural vulnerability to water scarcity in Iran
sources.methodology: Mixed methods; key informants; 266 households; multidimensional vulnerability method
sources.limitations: Strictly local; author-uploaded access rather than publisher page; cannot be generalized nationally. (ResearchGate)

sources.title: UNDP Iran CIWP Factsheet
geographic_coverage: Lake Urmia, Shadegan, Bakhtegan, Parishan, Anzali and participating villages
sources.methodology: Programme monitoring and self-reported results
sources.limitations: No independent counterfactual; performance figures are programme-reported. (UNDP)

sources.title: Conservation of Iranian Wetlands Project - Phase II (Scale-up)
sources.methodology: Administrative/project monitoring
sources.limitations: Achievement statements are implementing-agency reports, not independent impact evaluation. (UNDP)

sources.title: Terminal Evaluation consultancy notice - Lake Urmia and other wetlands
sources.methodology: Procurement notice for terminal evaluation
sources.limitations: Demonstrates commissioning of an evaluation, not its findings; final evaluation report not verified. (UNGM)

sources.title: FAO and Iran launch regional project to strengthen climate-resilient agriculture
sources.methodology: Programme design/workshop description
sources.limitations: Describes intended activities, not evaluated outcomes; agriculture-water statistic differs from WWA terminology. (FAOHome)

sources.title: Projects - FAO in Iran
sources.methodology: Administrative portfolio records
sources.limitations: Budgets and timeframes demonstrate committed/programmed capacity, not effectiveness. (FAOHome)

sources.title: Afghanistan Situation data portal
sources.methodology: Administrative humanitarian/return data
sources.limitations: Return/deportation data are not climate-attribution evidence; included to document current mobility and vulnerable populations. (UNHCR Data Portal)

sources.title: Nationally Determined Contribution, Updated in 2025
sources.methodology: Government policy, sectoral planning, institutional arrangements and targets
sources.limitations: Commitments and targets demonstrate intended policy/capacity, not evaluated outcomes.

sources.title: Second National Communication and First Biennial Update Report
geographic_coverage: National plus governorate and Southern Mesopotamian analyses
sources.methodology: ERA5/ECMWF, TerraClimate, NEX-GDDP 21-GCM ensemble, CORDEX, APSIM, sector/stakeholder assessment
sources.limitations: Some underlying strategic studies are older; local crop resolution explicitly limited; RCP framework rather than newer SSPs.

sources.title: Iraq Economic Monitor: A New Opportunity to Reform
sources.methodology: Macroeconomic analysis and special-focus synthesis of CCDR modeling
sources.limitations: Climate economic estimates are modelled scenarios, not observed causal effects. (World Bank)

sources.title: Tigris Adaptation and Healthy River Project - Concept-stage PID
sources.methodology: Sector/institutional diagnostic supporting project preparation
sources.limitations: Concept-stage project; proposed financing and activities must not be treated as achieved results.

sources.title: Advocacy Note: Water Scarcity and Climate Risks in Iraq
sources.methodology: Synthesis of water, displacement and humanitarian indicators
sources.limitations: Advocacy document rather than independent causal study; some underlying datasets are summarized rather than reproduced. (The United Nations in Iraq)

sources.title: Localised interlinkages between climate, peace, and security in Iraq
geographic_coverage: National synthesis plus selected local cases
sources.methodology: 15 semi-structured interviews, 46 internal reports/case studies, media/analytical sources; UN Climate Security Mechanism framework
sources.limitations: Qualitative and purposive; selected cases explicitly not exhaustive; some supporting sources are secondary.

sources.title: Climate change effects on conflict dynamics in Iraq: Makhmur, Tal Afar and Al-Rifai
sources.methodology: 20 in-depth interviews and 10 focus groups with 124 participants, plus contextual analysis
sources.limitations: Three purposively selected districts; women underrepresented in IDIs; perception evidence cannot establish national causality. (Berghof Foundation)

sources.title: Local Climate Change Adaptation Plan for Kurdistan Region - Iraq
sources.temporal_coverage: Historical baseline and future scenarios; plan current from 2024
sources.methodology: Participatory technical working group, climate vulnerability assessment, sector adaptation planning
sources.limitations: KRI-specific; proposed interventions/MRL are planned capacity rather than demonstrated outcomes.

sources.title: Independent Country Programme Evaluation: Iraq
geographic_coverage: North, central and south; national programme
sources.methodology: UNEG-standard evaluation; triangulation; 215 stakeholder interviews; field visits; GIS analysis
sources.limitations: Security/visa constraints cancelled planned visits to Kirkuk, Sulaymaniyah and Najaf; some projects unfinished.

sources.title: Evaluation of Iraq WFP Country Strategic Plan 2020-2024
sources.methodology: Independent strategic/portfolio evaluation of relevance, effectiveness, efficiency and performance
sources.limitations: Full report download was not accessible through the browsing environment; official page conclusions were accessible. Page displays “3 May 2023” despite evaluation coverage extending to Oct 2023, so publication-date metadata requires independent confirmation. (World Food Programme)

sources.title: GCF approves USD 39 million for SRVALI project
sources.organization: FAO / GCF / United Nations in Iraq
sources.methodology: Programme design, financing and intended beneficiary/outcome statements
sources.limitations: Announcement only; beneficiary numbers and expected effects are targets, not evaluated performance. (The United Nations in Iraq)

sources.title: *Lebanon's Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC 3.0) - Target Year 2035* (UNDP)
sources.organization: UNDP Lebanon / Government of Lebanon document mirror
sources.methodology: Official publication summary of NDC 3.0
sources.limitations: Linked 32.4 MB NDC PDF was identified but not independently parsed in this research session; claims below use only the verified publication-page text.

sources.title: *Lebanon National Adaptation Plan (NAP)* (UNDP)
sources.organization: UNDP Lebanon / Government of Lebanon document mirror
sources.methodology: Official NAP summary describing hazards, sectors, governance, finance, M&E and implementation roadmap
sources.limitations: Linked PDF was identified but claims here are restricted to verified publication-page text rather than unverified PDF page content.

sources.title: *Critical Investments in Key Sectors Can Help Lebanon Mitigate Climate Change Impact on Growth and Prepare for a Green Transition* (World Bank)
geographic_coverage: National; energy, water, transport, solid waste
sources.methodology: CCDR based on quantitative modelling, diagnostics, literature and stakeholder consultation
sources.limitations: Accessible release summarizes the CCDR; underlying climate model/scenario detail was not exposed in the release used for atomic projection claims.

sources.title: *New World Bank Program to Improve Water Supply and Quality and Advance Water Sector Reforms* (World Bank)
geographic_coverage: Greater Beirut and Mount Lebanon; national water reform
sources.methodology: Project design, water-sector diagnostic and reform measures
sources.limitations: Intended project outputs are not evidence of achieved performance.

sources.title: *Lebanon's Recovery and Reconstruction Needs Estimated at US$11 Billion* (World Bank)
sources.methodology: Rapid Damage and Needs Assessment; ground and remote information assembled with government, UN and partners
sources.limitations: Measures conflict damage/loss and recovery needs - not climate damage.

sources.title: *Lebanon Emergency Assistance Project: Frequently Asked Questions* (World Bank)
sources.methodology: Financing and implementation design for recovery of lifeline infrastructure
sources.limitations: Programme architecture and financing are inputs/intended mechanisms, not evaluated outcomes.

sources.title: *Country - Lebanon* operational data portal (UNHCR Data Portal)
sources.organization: UNHCR; IOM DTM data reproduced for IDP measures
sources.methodology: Administrative/operational refugee and displacement records
sources.limitations: Syrian registration has been suspended since 2015; “active record,” IDP and returnee categories have different definitions and dates.

sources.title: *Public Perceptions of Climate Change Risks in Lebanon - Regular Perception Surveys on Social Tensions, Wave 22*
sources.temporal_coverage: Fieldwork Oct-9 Nov 2025; comparison with earlier waves
sources.methodology: 5,002 interviews; weighted sample; 4,670 face-to-face and 332 remote in Bint Jbeil/Marjeyoun
sources.limitations: Self-reported experiences and perceptions; no meteorological attribution and no causal identification of climate effects on tension. Southern access constraints affected mode of interview.

sources.title: *Water as a Tool for Defusing Socio-Political Tension - Executive Summary*
sources.organization: UNICEF Lebanon; AUB-IFI; Search for Common Ground
geographic_coverage: Lebanon; local hotspot evidence including North Lebanon
sources.methodology: Mapping combining socioeconomic, water/environmental and socio-political indicators; programme experience
sources.limitations: Six-page executive summary, not an independent impact evaluation; local project observations cannot establish national causality.

sources.title: *Water Scarcity and Social Tensions in Lebanon: Lessons from the Bcharreh-Denniyeh Case*
sources.organization: ALEF - act for human rights, with Oxfam/SHiFT/Right to Play
sources.methodology: Secondary-source policy synthesis and case analysis
sources.limitations: Advocacy/policy source; many factual claims derive from secondary journalism or other reports. Its claim that the case previews a national trend is not adopted here.

sources.title: *Conflict Sensitivity Guidance for the Food Security and Agriculture sector (FSAS) in Lebanon*
sources.organization: International Alert with FSA Core Group; UNDP-supported
sources.methodology: Workshop, semi-structured interviews, validation meeting and sector best practice
sources.limitations: Guidance/programme theory rather than evaluation; some contextual statistics are reproduced from IPC and perception sources.

sources.title: *Evaluation of Lebanon Host Communities Support Project (2019-2022)*
sources.methodology: OECD-DAC, theory-based evaluation; interviews, 118 FGD participants including 57 women, site observation and document review, triangulation
sources.limitations: Not climate-specific; predates later conflict and 2025 climate policies. Evaluators identify important M&E weaknesses limiting outcome attribution.

sources.title: *Interplay of climate change-exacerbated rainfall, exposure and vulnerability led to widespread impacts in the Mediterranean region* (World Weather Attribution)
sources.temporal_coverage: Storm Daniel, Sep 2023; counterfactual climate comparison
sources.methodology: Observational products plus climate-model attribution analysis of extreme rainfall
sources.limitations: Large statistical uncertainty for Libya; single-event analysis; does not attribute dam failure or total disaster losses to climate change.

sources.title: *Climate, Peace and Security Fact Sheet: Libya 2024* (SIPRI)
geographic_coverage: National with Derna, Fezzan and other subnational examples
sources.methodology: Synthesis of climate, migration, water, conflict and governance datasets/literature
sources.limitations: Short synthesis rather than original causal study; some projection parameters/models are not reproduced; local examples cannot be generalized nationally.

sources.title: *Environment and Climate Change - Libya* (UNDP)
sources.methodology: UNDP contextual synthesis and programme description
sources.limitations: No explicit research methodology; programme intentions are not evidence of effectiveness; page lacks a clear publication/update date.

sources.title: *Final Evaluation: Support to Energy Transition and Climate Change Mitigation in Libya*
sources.methodology: Desk review, semi-structured interviews, participant survey and triangulation
sources.limitations: 14 interviewees; several important institutions unreachable; survey 58/193 trainees; limited female representation; predates some 2026 policy developments.

sources.title: *National Drought Management Strategy and Action Plan for Libya* (UNDP)
sources.methodology: National multi-sector drought-policy framework
sources.limitations: Publication establishes a strategy, not implementation or effectiveness; full implementation evidence was not available.

sources.title: *Libya Launches 2050 National Water Security Strategy to Combat Scarcity and Build Climate Resilience* (UNDP)
sources.methodology: Reports official endorsement following multi-year national dialogue
sources.limitations: Strategy targets are prospective; no independent outcome evaluation yet.

sources.title: *UN 2.0 in Action: Building Climate Resilience in Libya* (The United Nations in Libya)
sources.methodology: Aggregated UN programme reporting
sources.limitations: Outputs and reported reach are not independent impact estimates; causal effectiveness cannot be inferred.

sources.title: *Libya Operational Update - 31 October 2025* (UNHCR)
geographic_coverage: National with Alkufra and other operational locations
sources.methodology: Registration, protection monitoring, household/field information and operational data
sources.limitations: Refugee-focused rather than climate-focused; arrival estimates vary by method; cannot establish climate causality.

sources.title: *Libya Country Strategic Plan (2023-2025)* (The United Nations in Libya)
sources.methodology: Country needs assessment, UN common analysis, food-security/livelihood evidence
sources.limitations: Older baseline; programme design is not evaluation; climate, conflict and COVID-related constraints are often intertwined.

sources.title: *Libya - Country Overview* (World Bank)
sources.methodology: World Bank country monitoring and analytical synthesis
sources.limitations: Not a dedicated climate-FCV study; national indicators can hide regional variation.

sources.title: *Joint World Bank, EU, UN Report Assesses Damages Caused by Catastrophic Flooding in Libya* (World Bank)
sources.organization: World Bank / European Union / United Nations
sources.temporal_coverage: Sep 2023 event and immediate recovery assessment
sources.methodology: Rapid Damage and Needs Assessment using remote information, imagery, public and partner data
sources.limitations: Event-specific and eastern; publication page summarizes the full RDNA; remote methods and incomplete access create uncertainty.

sources.title: *Libya: Storm Daniel and Flooding Situation Report No. 4*
sources.methodology: Field/partner assessments, humanitarian coordination data and UNICEF response monitoring
sources.limitations: Early emergency snapshot; casualty and displacement figures subsequently changed; response outputs do not establish longer-term effectiveness.

sources.title: *National Communication submissions from Non-Annex I Parties* (UNFCCC)
sources.methodology: Official Party-submission table
sources.limitations: Covers National Communications, not the full universe of domestic climate policy; blank registry fields do not imply absence of all domestic climate activity.

sources.title: *Mali: Climate Resilience and Environmental Governance*
sources.temporal_coverage: Historical climate through 2023; policy context to 2025
sources.methodology: Literature/data synthesis using a nexus framework; expert review
sources.limitations: Synthesis, not causal evaluation; some climate-conflict wording stronger than underlying evidence warrants. (World Bank)

sources.title: *Mali Economic Update - Special Chapter: Strengthening Financial Resilience of Pastoralists to Drought*
sources.methodology: Six climate-model/emissions combinations linked to biophysical/economic modelling; drought analysis
sources.limitations: Future precipitation highly uncertain; economic model is scenario-based. (World Bank)

sources.title: *Contribution Déterminée au Niveau National révisée*
sources.methodology: Government climate commitments, adaptation/mitigation priorities
sources.limitations: UNFCCC PDF is ~20 MB and could not be rendered by the browser interface; the direct file was successfully retrieved separately. Section §6.2 was cross-checked against the public FAOLEX mirror. Exact PDF page for §6.2: LOCATOR NOT VERIFIED. (UNFCCC)

sources.title: *Agence de l’Environnement et du Développement Durable: session du Comité de coordination et suivi de mise en œuvre de la CDN*
sources.methodology: Administrative reporting on NDC coordination
sources.limitations: Describes process and commitments, not independently evaluated implementation outcomes. (Government of Mali)

sources.title: *Climate-related Security Risks and Peacebuilding in Mali*
geographic_coverage: Mali, with emphasis on north/centre and MINUSMA
sources.methodology: Qualitative process tracing; literature/UN documents; 57 interviews/correspondence
sources.limitations: Single case/plausibility probe; interview perspectives; written before MINUSMA withdrawal and subsequent conflict changes. (SIPRI)

sources.title: *Is climate exacerbating the root causes of conflict in Mali? A climate security analysis through a structural equation modeling approach*
sources.organization: Frontiers in Climate / Alliance Bioversity-CIAT authors
geographic_coverage: National household sample merged at cercle level
sources.methodology: LSMS-ISA + CHIRPS + ACLED; structural-equation/path mediation
sources.limitations: Observational model; one specified food-production pathway; associations should not be read as proof of event-level causality. (Frontiers)

sources.title: *Mali Humanitarian Situation Report No. 1*
sources.methodology: Cluster/government/UN reporting and UNICEF programme monitoring
sources.limitations: Humanitarian estimates can be revised; UNICEF outputs are not independent impact evaluation. (UNICEF)

sources.title: *Situation report on the crisis in Mali - April 2026*
geographic_coverage: Bamako, Gao, Mopti, Kidal and affected IDP sites
sources.methodology: Operational monitoring
sources.limitations: Short-period operational source; response counts are outputs, not effectiveness estimates. (United Nations Population Fund)

sources.title: *Humanitarian aid cuts push millions deeper into hunger amid rising violence and population displacement in West and Central Africa*
sources.methodology: Cadre Harmonisé and WFP operational evidence
sources.limitations: WFP is an implementing agency; ration comparison is not presented as a randomized impact evaluation. (World Food Programme)

sources.title: *GIEWS Country Brief: Mali*
sources.methodology: Cadre Harmonisé, production/price monitoring and seasonal forecasts
sources.limitations: Older than 2026 humanitarian sources; seasonal forecasts are prospective and conflict remains a major confounder. (FAOHome)

sources.title: *Impacts of Development Aid to Mali 2008-2021: A Systematic Review of Evaluation Reports - Part I*
sources.organization: Netherlands Ministry of Foreign Affairs, IOB-commissioned research
sources.methodology: 6,296 title/abstract screens; 588 full texts; 104 Mali studies included; methodological quality thresholds
sources.limitations: Evidence ends in 2021; country-level evaluations were included by default without the same quality threshold.

sources.title: *Mali Community Resilience and Inclusive Services Project - Malidenko (P505025), Project Appraisal Document*
sources.methodology: Project appraisal, institutional and fiduciary design
sources.limitations: Design evidence only: committees, facilitators and grievance systems are intended mechanisms, not proven outcomes. (World Bank)

sources.title: Myanmar Climate Fact Sheet 2024
sources.organization: Red Cross Red Crescent Climate Centre / Myanmar Red Cross Society
sources.methodology: Synthesis of IPCC, World Bank, government and specialist evidence
sources.limitations: Secondary synthesis; several component datasets predate 2024.

sources.title: Myanmar's National Adaptation Programme of Action (NAPA) to Climate Change
geographic_coverage: National plus three PRA townships and seven physiographic regions
sources.methodology: PRECIS 20×20 km, A2 scenario; seven stations; PRA/RRA and sector working groups
sources.limitations: Legacy model/scenario; limited station representation; predates current conflict.

sources.title: Nationally Determined Contributions
sources.methodology: National policy framework and sectoral adaptation priorities
sources.limitations: Policy intentions are not implementation evidence; institutional context changed sharply after 2021.

sources.title: Climate, Peace and Security Fact Sheet: Myanmar
geographic_coverage: National with Dry Zone, Rakhine, Karenni and border examples
sources.methodology: Triangulated conflict, humanitarian, livelihood and climate literature
sources.limitations: Four-page synthesis; causal pathways often rest on secondary evidence.

sources.title: Climate change as an arena of wartime political struggles: Greening of military rule and resistance in Myanmar
sources.organization: Environment and Planning E: Nature and Space
sources.methodology: Digital ethnography plus 15 interviews
sources.limitations: Full text restricted in this verification session; abstract and data statement checked.

sources.title: Myanmar September 2024 Typhoon Yagi Floods: Flood Extent Note
sources.methodology: Satellite flood extent, exposure modelling, ground/report corroboration
sources.limitations: Cannot cleanly separate Yagi from concurrent monsoon flooding; exposure ≠ damage.

sources.title: Myanmar Emergency
sources.methodology: WFP needs estimates and operational reporting
sources.limitations: Operational reporting, not an impact evaluation.

sources.title: Country - Myanmar Operational Data Portal
sources.methodology: UN in Myanmar/UNHCR operational displacement estimates
sources.limitations: Dynamic estimates; conflict/access constraints affect enumeration.

sources.title: Cyclone Mocha: Aid efforts severely hampered by new restrictions
sources.methodology: MSF field operations and staff observations
sources.limitations: Organization-specific operational perspective; not nationally representative.

sources.title: Mid-term Evaluation of Addressing Climate Change Risks on Water Resources and Food Security in the Dry Zone of Myanmar
sources.methodology: Evaluation mission, project monitoring, field evidence and ratings
sources.limitations: Pre-coup; project-specific; mid-term rather than terminal.

sources.title: Myanmar's Enduring Polycrisis: Four Years into a Tumultuous Journey
geographic_coverage: National, examples including Rakhine and Chin
sources.methodology: UNDP socioeconomic synthesis
sources.limitations: Publication page verified; 12.4 MB full report was not retrievable in this browsing session, so only page claims are used.

sources.title: Strengthening Food Security in Myanmar: A Roadmap for Localized Action
sources.methodology: Food-security framework and policy/programme analysis
sources.limitations: Recommendations are intended responses, not demonstrated outcomes; full PDF not parsed in session.

sources.title: Supporting the People of Myanmar
sources.methodology: Project portfolio and reported outputs through third-party implementers
sources.limitations: Beneficiary/output reporting should not be read as evaluated effectiveness.

sources.title: Update of the First NDC of Mozambique (UNFCCC4)
sources.temporal_coverage: Historical climate 1960-2005; extreme events 1980-2019; projections 2046-2065 and 2080-2100; NDC actions mainly 2020-2025
sources.methodology: National synthesis; historical observations from 32 synoptic stations; seven GCMs; INGD/DeSInventar event data
sources.limitations: Projection excerpt does not identify an emissions/RCP scenario; some underlying studies date from 2009; event records are not attribution studies.

sources.title: Mozambique's National Adaptation Plan (UNFCCC5)
sources.temporal_coverage: Current planning framework drawing on historical evidence and forward adaptation needs
sources.methodology: Extensive consultation; sector/thematic adaptation actions; institutional and capacity assessment; theory of change
sources.limitations: Government planning document, not an independent evaluation; several vulnerability datasets acknowledged as incomplete.

sources.title: Mozambique Country Climate and Development Report (CCDR) (World Bank6)
sources.methodology: Climate-development modelling and economic diagnostic; only publication-page findings used here
sources.limitations: Linked full PDF exceeded crawler access limit; exact claims retained only where the verified publication page provides them.

sources.title: Localised Climate-Related Security Risk Assessment: Mozambique Case Study (GPPAC7)
sources.organization: Global Partnership for the Prevention of Armed Conflict (GPPAC)
sources.methodology: Five focus groups; multistakeholder dialogues; questionnaire to 110 stakeholders; local officials, traditional leaders, communities, climate experts and peacebuilders
sources.limitations: Local perceptions and qualitative synthesis; cannot be generalized nationally; authors explicitly state immediate impact of the assessment was difficult to establish.

sources.title: Conflict Analysis of Cabo Delgado Province in Mozambique
geographic_coverage: Ancuabe, Chiure, Mecufi and Pemba, Cabo Delgado
sources.temporal_coverage: Conflict since 2017; primary study contemporary to report
sources.methodology: Desk review, key-informant interviews, quantitative survey, n=172
sources.limitations: Not a climate study; intentionally used to retain independent conflict drivers and local peace capacities. Sample locations are not representative of all Cabo Delgado or Mozambique.

sources.title: Mozambique: IPC Acute Food Insecurity Snapshot, Oct 2025-Mar 2026 (IPCinfo8)
sources.temporal_coverage: Oct 2025-Mar 2026, with linked analyses extending to Sep 2026
sources.methodology: Combination of post-shock and post-harvest IPC analyses
sources.limitations: Not designed to isolate causal effects of climate versus conflict/markets; geographic coverage differs between component analyses.

sources.title: Mozambique Humanitarian Situation Report No. 2, February 2026 (UNICEF9)
sources.methodology: Operational monitoring drawing on displacement assessments and government/partner reporting
sources.limitations: Humanitarian operational report rather than independent evaluation; programme outputs should not be read as demonstrated long-term outcomes.

sources.title: Humanitarian Action for Children - Mozambique Appeal 2026 (UNICEF10)
sources.methodology: Humanitarian needs synthesis plus planned targets and programme strategy
sources.limitations: Appeal document; targets and intended mechanisms are not evidence of effectiveness.

sources.title: Inter-Agency Humanitarian Evaluation of the Response to Cyclone Idai in Mozambique (World Food Programme11)
sources.methodology: Independent collective-response evaluation; representative survey of affected population plus evaluative evidence
sources.limitations: Publication page fully accessible; linked full evaluation download was not retrievable through the crawler, so only verified publication-page findings are used.

sources.title: Seeds, Cash, and Preparedness: FAO's Anticipatory Actions (FAOHome12)
geographic_coverage: Machanga, Sofala; Maganja da Costa, Zambézia
sources.methodology: FAO administrative/programme reporting on anticipatory action
sources.limitations: Self-reported implementation/output evidence; no independent counterfactual or outcome evaluation.

sources.title: Climate Change Adaptation Action and Mainstreaming in Mozambique - Final Evaluation (UNDP IEO Evaluation Resource Center13)
sources.methodology: Document/financial review, Maputo mission, stakeholder interviews, primary/secondary evidence
sources.limitations: Old relative to current institutional conditions; evaluator found weak monitoring and inability to cleanly attribute observed mainstreaming results to the project.

sources.title: Contribution Déterminée au Niveau National révisée
sources.methodology: National synthesis; CMIP5 ensemble of 29 models for cited projections; RCP4.5/RCP8.5
sources.limitations: Projection generation is now dated; some impact statistics originate in older national reports.

sources.title: “Le Niger adopte son Plan National d’Adaptation” (UNDP)
sources.methodology: Description of national validation process, actors and capacity-building
sources.limitations: Process/output evidence, not evaluation of NAP effectiveness.

sources.title: Niger's Adaptation Communication (UNFCCC)
sources.methodology: National synthesis of adaptation policies, programmes, gaps and support needs
sources.limitations: Government self-assessment; project listings do not establish outcomes.

sources.title: CPF FY26-FY31, Annex 5: Streamlined Country Diagnostic
sources.methodology: Synthesis of socioeconomic, FCV, climate, institutional and sector evidence
sources.limitations: Diagnostic synthesis, not a causal climate-security study; some estimates rely on earlier WB work.

sources.title: Niger - Emergency and Resilience (FAOHome)
sources.methodology: FAO emergency assessment and programme data
sources.limitations: Operational synthesis; headline counts may update; programme plans are not evaluations.

sources.title: GIEWS Country Brief: Republic of the Niger (FAOHome)
geographic_coverage: Niger; Tillabéri, Diffa, Tahoua and other named regions
sources.methodology: Crop monitoring, cereal balance, prices, earth observation and Cadre Harmonisé evidence
sources.limitations: Short early-warning product; projected CH figures subject to later updates.

sources.title: Acute Malnutrition Situation Aug.-Nov. 2025 and Projections to July 2026 (IPCinfo)
sources.methodology: IPC classification and multi-factor driver analysis
sources.limitations: Projection periods are not observations; nutrition causation is multifactorial.

sources.title: Humanitarian Situation Report No. 1, reporting period Jan.-Mar. 2026
geographic_coverage: Niger; detailed Tillabéri, Diffa, Dosso and other areas
sources.methodology: Operational monitoring, sector reporting and administrative programme data
sources.limitations: UNICEF programme reporting, not independent evaluation.

sources.title: Niger Operation Factsheet, January-June 2025 (UNHCR Data Portal)
sources.methodology: UNHCR operational reporting
sources.limitations: Publication page accessible; PDF binary did not render in browser. Reported contributions are not independently evaluated outcomes.

sources.title: Climate Change and Violent Conflict in West Africa: Assessing the Evidence (SIPRI)
sources.methodology: Systematic review of academic climate-conflict evidence
sources.limitations: Regional and explicitly finds a limited research base.

sources.title: Niger Country Strategy and Programme Evaluation (ioe.ifad.org)
sources.methodology: Independent country strategy/programme evaluation
sources.limitations: Covers IFAD, not Niger's entire adaptation portfolio; period ends 2020.

sources.title: Climate Change and Conflict in the Sahel: Findings from Niger and Burkina Faso (ResearchGate)
geographic_coverage: Niger and Burkina Faso; Niger field sites incl. Tahoua/Tillabéri
sources.methodology: Climate/livelihood synthesis with interviews, focus groups, institutional evidence and climate analyses
sources.limitations: Foundational but old; some statistics and institutional conditions are obsolete; local findings cannot be generalized.

sources.title: *Country Climate and Development Report: Nigeria* (PreventionWeb4)
sources.methodology: Multi-sector development/climate diagnostic and scenario analysis
sources.limitations: Relevant report summary verified; page-level PDF locators were not available in the browsing interface, so only publication-page claims are used.

sources.title: *Federal Republic of Nigeria Adaptation Communication to the UNFCCC* (UNFCCC5)
sources.temporal_coverage: Historical; policy status to 2021; projections to 2090s
sources.methodology: Government synthesis of climate evidence, vulnerability, policy, institutions and adaptation actions
sources.limitations: Some climate projections and underlying studies are older; several programme entries are descriptions rather than evaluations.

sources.title: *Climate Change and Violent Conflict in West Africa: Assessing the Evidence* (SIPRI2)
sources.methodology: Systematic review organized around climate-conflict pathways
sources.limitations: Regional synthesis; Nigeria evidence is concentrated on pastoral mobility, Middle Belt conflict and Lake Chad. Authors themselves describe the academic evidence base as limited.

sources.title: *Implementation Completion Report Review: Erosion & Watershed Management Project (P124905)* (World Bank7)
sources.methodology: IEG review of project design, implementation, M&E and completion evidence
sources.limitations: The review says the critical vulnerability-reduction outcome was inadequately measured and the 2022 impact-evaluation results were not reported.

sources.title: *Conflict and shrinking humanitarian assistance drives northern Nigeria hunger crisis...* (World Food Programme8)
geographic_coverage: Nine conflict-affected northern states; detailed Borno/NE evidence
sources.methodology: Cadre Harmonisé results plus WFP operational/access evidence
sources.limitations: Humanitarian source; its statements on recruitment/exploitation include reported observations and risk interpretations, not causal impact evaluation.

sources.title: *Nigeria: Acute Malnutrition Situation... Oct 2025-Sep 2026* (IPCinfo9)
geographic_coverage: 204 LGAs in Northeast, Northwest, North Central
sources.methodology: IPC acute-malnutrition analysis and projections
sources.limitations: Not national coverage; should not be generalized to southern Nigeria.

sources.title: *Nigeria country profile* (UNHCR10)
sources.methodology: UNHCR operational and protection data
sources.limitations: Aggregated operational evidence; some numbers refer to end-2024 while funding/overview text is newer.

sources.title: *Nigeria - Forcibly Displaced Populations*
sources.methodology: UNHCR/IOM DTM/NIS/NCFRMI displacement data
sources.limitations: One-page snapshot; causal categories are broad and differ by region.

sources.title: NEMA DG speech on disaster-risk financing, including 2024 EOC flood dashboard (NEMA11)
sources.methodology: NEMA Emergency Operations Centre incident-dashboard totals
sources.limitations: Dashboard methodology and definitions are not described on the page. No climate-change attribution is made.

sources.title: *Maiduguri flood update* (NEMA12)
sources.methodology: NEMA field/response reporting
sources.limitations: Local event only; no climate attribution analysis.

sources.title: *NEMA Conducts Flood Impact Assessment in Surulere Communities, Lagos State* (NEMA13)
sources.methodology: NEMA field assessment
sources.limitations: Highly local; rainfall was one of several reported causal factors.

sources.title: *NEMA Commences Review of National Disaster Management Framework and Response Plan...* (NEMA14)
sources.methodology: Official description of framework-review process
sources.limitations: Records an institutional process and intended improvements, not evaluated performance.

sources.title: *DG NEMA Attends AATF Meeting as Vice President Directs Activation of Early Action Platform for Flood Response* (NEMA15)
sources.methodology: Official account of anticipatory-action activation and funding
sources.limitations: Intended mechanism/output only; no evidence yet of avoided losses or improved outcomes.

sources.title: Climate, Peace and Security Assessment: Papua New Guinea
sources.organization: adelphi research / Weathering Risk, with Asian Development Bank and United Nations Development Programme
sources.temporal_coverage: Historical and current conditions with SSP projections through 2100.
sources.methodology: Mixed-method climate-security assessment combining literature, climate-risk analysis, interviews, workshops, expert interpretation, and regional case studies.
sources.limitations: The synthesis does not causally identify most pathways; some findings are locality-specific and projection uncertainty remains.

sources.title: Papua New Guinea's Enhanced Nationally Determined Contribution 2020
sources.organization: Government of Papua New Guinea and Climate Change and Development Authority
sources.temporal_coverage: Policy targets and information needs mainly through 2030.
sources.methodology: Government policy submission presenting sector baselines, consultations, quantified adaptation targets, and stated information gaps.
sources.limitations: Targets are intended commitments rather than evaluated implementation; the document predates later policy and hazard developments.

sources.title: Papua New Guinea: Technical Assistance Report - Climate Policy Diagnostic
sources.temporal_coverage: Diagnostic mission in July 2024 and policy status through publication.
sources.methodology: A fiscal and institutional diagnostic based on desk review, a government mission, consultations, and sector analysis.
sources.limitations: Not an FCV study; historical climate series have gaps and recommendations are not implementation outcomes.

sources.title: Assessing the Evidence: Migration, Environment and Climate Change in Papua New Guinea
sources.temporal_coverage: Migration and displacement evidence available through 2014.
sources.methodology: A literature review supplemented by six key-informant interviews and technical working-group feedback.
sources.limitations: Older and largely secondary evidence; volcanic, development, and climate-related mobility drivers must remain distinct.

sources.title: Beyond Barriers: Papua New Guinea Case Study
sources.organization: Humanitarian Advisory Group and World Vision / Australian Humanitarian Partnership
geographic_coverage: Four communities and relevant provincial and national institutions
sources.methodology: Review of more than 20 documents, eight interviews, 12 focus groups, and 167 community participants.
sources.limitations: A four-community qualitative sample cannot represent all provinces or customary settings and is not an outcome evaluation.

sources.title: Implementation Completion Report Review: Rural Service Delivery and Local Governance (P126157)
geographic_coverage: Eight pilot local-level governments in two provinces
sources.temporal_coverage: Project implementation and inspection shortly after closure.
sources.methodology: Independent review of completion evidence, performance indicators, project records, and reported site inspections.
sources.limitations: Project-specific and geographically narrow; weak monitoring and short follow-up constrain attribution and sustainability assessment.

sources.title: Evaluation of the UNDP Papua New Guinea Country Programme 2018-2022
sources.methodology: Independent evaluation using document review, interviews, field visits, triangulation, and OECD-DAC-oriented criteria.
sources.limitations: Limited interviews and field provinces; some climate-policy products were incomplete or too recent for outcome assessment.

sources.title: Food Assistance to El Nino Affected Populations in Papua New Guinea
geographic_coverage: Affected local-level governments in Papua New Guinea
sources.temporal_coverage: 2015-2016 El Nino drought and frost episode.
sources.methodology: Operational assessment drawing on mobile vulnerability analysis and mapping with the National Disaster Centre.
sources.limitations: Implementing-agency evidence, not an independent or nationally representative evaluation; findings apply to assessed affected areas.

sources.title: Common Country Analysis 2024 Update
sources.organization: United Nations Resident Coordinator's Office in Papua New Guinea
geographic_coverage: Papua New Guinea, with subnational examples
sources.temporal_coverage: Conditions and UN analysis available through 2024.
sources.methodology: A UN country-team desk synthesis incorporating country evidence and expert inputs.
sources.limitations: Secondary expert synthesis rather than causal analysis; national aggregation obscures provincial and ecological differences.

sources.title: Taking Locally Led Climate and Security Actions Seriously in Papua New Guinea
geographic_coverage: Papua New Guinea, with selected local and provincial inquiry
sources.methodology: Desk review, interviews, participatory workshop, and locally led climate-security analysis.
sources.limitations: Limited province-specific coverage; parts of government and private-sector perspectives were underrepresented.

sources.title: Disaster Displacement: Papua New Guinea Country Briefing
sources.organization: Internal Displacement Monitoring Centre and Asian Development Bank
sources.temporal_coverage: Event data through 2021 with prospective risk modelling and a local survey.
sources.methodology: Disaster-displacement database, probabilistic modelling, and survey of 150 displaced and 152 non-displaced people.
sources.limitations: Likely under-recording and one non-representative local survey; geological and climatic hazards require separate treatment.

sources.title: *West Bank and Gaza Country Climate and Development Report*
geographic_coverage: West Bank and Gaza with city/subregional analysis
sources.temporal_coverage: Historical climate through 2020; projections to 2055/2090; socioeconomic evidence mainly pre-2023
sources.methodology: CMIP6/SSP projections, sector modelling, World Bank socioeconomic and institutional analysis
sources.limitations: Predates the October 2023 conflict and subsequent transformation of Gaza; some sector estimates are model-based.

sources.title: *The State of Palestine’s First Nationally Determined Contributions - Updated Submission*
sources.methodology: National policy process; sector implementation action plans; costing and institutional arrangements
sources.limitations: Policy commitments and targets, not independently demonstrated outcomes; predates post-2023 destruction.

sources.title: *Conflict and social vulnerability to climate change: lessons from Gaza*
sources.organization: Mason, Zeitoun & el Sheikh; *Climate and Development*
geographic_coverage: Gaza Strip; stakeholder evidence centred on Gaza City
sources.methodology: Interviews, questionnaire, workshops and cognitive mapping; 12 stakeholder representatives in key workshops
sources.limitations: Small qualitative sample; important political actors excluded/unavailable; very old relative to 2026 conditions; no causal identification.

sources.title: *Compounding Vulnerability: Impacts of Climate Change on Palestinians in Gaza and the West Bank*
sources.organization: Mason, Zeitoun & Mimi; *Journal of Palestine Studies*
geographic_coverage: Gaza and selected West Bank localities
sources.methodology: Analysis of UNDP consultations and supporting literature/case evidence
sources.limitations: Qualitative and interpretive; locality-specific; pre-2023 and not a national causal study.

sources.title: *The political economy of water and sanitation in Palestine’s Gaza Strip: A scoping review*
sources.methodology: Scoping review of 17 peer-reviewed and 37 grey-literature sources
sources.limitations: Heterogeneous literature, much of it low-to-moderate direct relevance; political-economy synthesis rather than causal impact evaluation.

sources.title: *ICR Review: Water Supply & Sewage System Improvement (P101289)*
sources.methodology: Independent desk review of implementation completion evidence and results framework
sources.limitations: Pre-2023; some outcome data weak; focused on one WASH project, not climate adaptation as a whole.

sources.title: *Rapid Damage and Needs Assessment - Gaza Strip, April 2026*
sources.organization: World Bank, United Nations and European Union
sources.methodology: Remote sensing, ground-verified information and standard RDNA damage/loss/needs methodology across 17 sectors
sources.limitations: Access constraints required substantial remote assessment; authors call for later on-the-ground sector assessments; conflict damage is not climate damage. (The World Bank5)

sources.title: *Economic Update on the West Bank and Gaza*
geographic_coverage: West Bank and Gaza, separately where data permit
sources.temporal_coverage: Information through end-Apr 2026; principal economic data through 2025/Q1 2026
sources.methodology: Macro-fiscal, labour, financial, energy and social-sector monitoring drawing on official and partner data
sources.limitations: Rapidly changing conflict/access context; economic monitoring, not a climate or impact evaluation. (The World Bank6)

sources.title: *Humanitarian Situation Report - 23 July 2026*
geographic_coverage: Gaza and West Bank; detailed West Bank localities
sources.temporal_coverage: West Bank reporting primarily 14-20 Jul 2026; cumulative indicators
sources.methodology: OCHA/cluster operational reporting, incident monitoring and partner data
sources.limitations: Humanitarian monitoring rather than causal research; data can be revised; politically sensitive claims require attribution. (OCHA Palestine3)

sources.title: *Humanitarian Situation Update - Analysis of the Response to the Needs of Children at Mid-year 2026*
sources.methodology: UNICEF operational monitoring and partner/sector estimates
sources.limitations: Humanitarian operational estimates; no climate attribution or counterfactual evaluation. (UNICEF7)

sources.title: *Gaza Strip: Acute Food Insecurity Situation for 16 April-30 June 2026 and Projection for 1 July-31 December 2026*
sources.methodology: IPC evidence-convergence classification and projection
sources.limitations: Projection depends on scenario assumptions; improvement attributed by IPC to assistance is synthesis, not randomized causal evaluation. (IPCinfo8)

sources.title: *UNICEF in the State of Palestine Humanitarian Situation Update - The West Bank*
